title: EMS Diesel Generator Communication Configuration
description: Modbus connection and generator parameters for the Diesel Generator (DG). Supports both Modbus RTU (RS485) and Modbus TCP. Monitors generator status and controls auto-start for backup power during grid outages.

_schema_version.description: Schema version for migration detection. Must match the schema expected version.

connection.description: Modbus transport layer configuration. Protocol selects RTU (RS485 serial) or TCP (Ethernet).

protocol.description: Modbus transport protocol. 'rtu' uses RS485 serial, 'tcp' uses Ethernet.

slave_id.description: Modbus slave/unit ID of the generator controller.

device.description: Serial device path for Modbus RTU. Example: /dev/ttyUSB3 or /dev/ttyS4.

baud_rate.description: Serial baud rate for Modbus RTU. Must match generator controller configuration. Default: 9600.

parity.description: Serial parity for Modbus RTU. N=None, E=Even, O=Odd. Default: N.

stopbits.description: Number of serial stop bits for Modbus RTU. Default: 1.

host.description: IP address or hostname of the generator controller for Modbus TCP.

port.description: TCP port number for Modbus TCP. Standard Modbus TCP port is 502.

generator.description: Generator hardware parameters. Defines rated capacity, fuel type, and auto-start behavior.

rated_power_kw.description: Nominal rated output power of the generator. Used by control_manager to plan load dispatch. Must match nameplate rating.

fuel_type.description: Generator fuel type. Affects fuel consumption logging and maintenance scheduling.

auto_start.description: Enable automatic generator start when grid fails and BESS SOC is below threshold. Set false for sites requiring manual generator operation.

timing.description: Modbus polling interval and timeout configuration for generator communication.

poll_interval_ms.description: How often to poll generator registers for status and power output readings.

timeout_ms.description: Modbus request timeout. If no response within this window, the request is retried or a fault is raised.
